header: The six municipalities that used the most electricity
lead: Not a competition and not a target — the ranking mostly follows how much industry each municipality has, which is why Ashcombe has been first every year since the network was joined up.
note: Electricity supplied to all connections in each municipality during 2026, in gigawatt hours. The eight municipalities not listed account for 256 GWh between them, bringing the total to 1,184 GWh.

metrics.title: Ashcombe
metrics.text: Two paper mills account for roughly half of it.

metrics.title: Old Harbour
metrics.text: Down 9 GWh on 2025 after the cold store closed.
